answer_4.quote: We report spending about 4000 USD for annotating a test set of 3500 images across 7 countries, with only 1 annotator per image. All outputs are given a rating on a scale of 1-5 by human annotators, across multiple dimensions including visual change, semantic equivalence, cultural relevance, naturalness and offensiveness.
answer_4.guideline: Rating on a scale of 1-5 across multiple dimensions
